one_liner: Entry-level Air Force contracting trainee who prepares bids, quotes and proposals and helps monitor contracts, on a developmental track to GS-12.
fit_summary: This Direct Hire program is for current students and graduates whose degree was awarded within the last two years. Daniel's M.A. is from 2016 and his resume shows no current enrollment, so he can't qualify.
eligibility: Limited to students enrolled full-time or graduates whose degree is no more than two years old. His M.A. is from May 2016, so he is outside the window.
A bachelor's degree from an accredited institution is the basic requirement for non-military, non-DoD applicants.

You also need one of these: one year of GS-05-level specialized experience in contracting functions, or a bachelor's with Superior Academic Achievement (GPA 2.95+, upper third, or honor society), or one year of graduate study in the listed fields.
A Top Secret clearance is required. Expect to obtain it after selection, which means a background investigation.
keywords: soliciting, evaluating, negotiating, and awarding contracts
compliance with the terms and conditions
strategy: Skip this one: it is only for current students and graduates whose degree is no more than two years old, and his M.A. is from 2016.
Look at other 1102 trainee jobs open to the public, where his proposal and procurement work at IEM can count.
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you had to follow detailed rules or procedures precisely.
How do you prioritize several deadlines at once?
Describe something complex you learned quickly on the job.
How would you explain a contract requirement to someone who disagrees with it?
watch_outs: This posting is limited to students and recent graduates (degree within two years), so it is not open to all applicants.
The Top Secret clearance requirement means a lengthy background investigation.
Locations are Air Force-wide and the role is not remote, so you may need to relocate away from Manassas.
GS-7 pay ($50,460–$65,599) is low for the DC area at the start, though the career ladder runs to GS-12.
